items.title: Glenn Zottola interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 7, 2020
items.q: That kind of music was one of the reasons I decided to join Bob Wilber.

ctx.x: That kind of music was one of the reasons I decided to join Bob Wilber. I was like at the peak of my bebop era when that music started to come in, electronic. And I went, instead of moving forward I went back. I said let me go back to Louis. Because I didn’t see any place to go with that music. You know? It was so loud oh my God.
Yeah and it didn’t have much to do with the trumpet.
